description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin develops mission software solutions for complex national security challenges. The Software Engineer will work on cross-functional Agile teams to implement secure, full-stack web and Java mission capabilities for USSTRATCOM’s Strategic Mission Planning and Execution System in a DevSecOps environment.
Full-stack mission systems software engineer for secure, usable capability delivery

Responsibilities:
• Work as part of a cross-functional Agile team to implement new mission capabilities
• Reflect secure coding, architectural, and usability best practices as you work Full Stack across the mission architecture
• Collaborating with architecture, cyber, test, and product owner stakeholders to deliver capabilities

Requirements:
• • BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent STEM field
• • Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a government security clearance.  This position is located at a facility that requires special access
• • Ability to develop Web or Java code in an Agile / DevSecOps team environment

Preferred:
• • Familiarity with development tooling VS Code,  GitLab, Gradle, GIT, JUnit, Selenium, JIRA
• • Experience with JavaScript Frameworks / Libraries (React/Angular/Vue), CSS, and HTML
• • Experience with Web Services (REST) or JSON/XML
• • Experience with Kafka
• • Java Spring, Spring Boot experience
• • Experience developing using microservice architectures
• • Experience with Relational Database Access / SQL / JPA / Hibernate
• • Engineering experience with AFNWC SMPES, MPAS, NPES Systems
